nodes.title: Should a refund larger than what is left be capped or rejected?
nodes.body: The proposal caps it (refund $60 when $75 is asked). The build rejects it. Support says customers often type the original price.

options.label: Cap it to what is left
options.detail: Matches the proposal. Customers get the most they can.

options.label: Reject with 409
options.detail: Forces staff to type the right amount.

nodes.title: Who talks to whom after the change
nodes.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant P as Refund dialog
  participant C as refunds.create
  participant DB as orders
  participant Pay as Payments
  P->>C: orderId, amount (ceiling)
  C->>DB: SELECT … WHERE id = :orderId AND user_id = :userId
  DB-->>C: total, refunded
  C->>C: amount = min(asked, total − refunded)
  C->>Pay: refund(amount)
  Pay-->>C: refundId
  C-->>P: refundId
